nodes.summary: If `R` is adically complete at its maximal ideal, then `MvPowerSeries σ R` is adically complete at its maximal ideal.
nodes.title: Adic completeness of multivariate power series

nodes.summary: A finite local extension of an adically complete local ring is adically complete at its maximal ideal.
nodes.title: Finite local extensions of adically complete rings are complete

nodes.summary: The adic completion of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian.
nodes.title: Adic completion of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian
Kernels of evaluation maps out of adic completions

nodes.summary: A ring is adically complete at a nilpotent ideal.
nodes.title: Adic completeness at a nilpotent ideal

nodes.summary: If `𝓞` is adically complete at `(p)` and `R` is finite free over `𝓞`, then `R` is adically complete at `(p)`.
nodes.title: Finite free modules over adically complete rings are complete

nodes.summary: A Noetherian local ring of Krull dimension at least two has an adic completion of Krull dimension at least two.
nodes.title: Adic completion preserves Krull dimension at least two

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
